data.revised_prompt:
Create exactly one clean HD 2D game FX sprite sheet, 1024x1024, arranged as an invisible 2x2 grid of four equal 512x512 cells. Use the attached cute glossy blue narwhal avatar only as visual reference for palette and material language: ivory white, aqua belly tones, electric cyan highlights, violet-blue speckles, pearl bubbles, soft underwater glow, polished clean sprite rendering. Use the layout guide only to infer equal cell spacing/centering/safe padding; do not reproduce any guide elements.

STRICT BACKGROUND: entire canvas is 100% solid flat magenta #FF00FF, including spaces between cells. No visible grid lines, no boxes, no labels, no borders, no guide background, no text, no watermark, no checkerboard. Leave generous magenta margin around every FX element; no element crosses or touches any cell edge.

SUBJECT RULE: attack effect sheet only, no character. Do NOT draw Noah's body, no full narwhal, no face, no eyes, no fins, no tail, no complete horn object, no card UI, no weapon, no hand, no character silhouette. Effects may be abstract ivory horn-energy, piercing water lances, starry bubbles, crescent splash trails, luminous impact shapes. Keep as pure FX asset.

Concept: “Noah tusk break” — a fast magical narwhal-horn strike made from compressed water and ivory light; cute, bright, aquatic, piercing, readable at game size, not a generic splash and not an actual detached weapon.

Four frames, centered in each equal cell with consistent scale and similar bounding boxes:
1) Top-left wind-up: compact ivory-white triangular glint at center, two short aqua crescent ripples, tiny cyan star speckles, pearl bubbles pulled inward.
2) Top-right release: diagonal horn-energy lance thrusting from lower-left toward upper-right, abstract tapered ivory-white core with cyan water edges, violet-blue sparkle trail, small rounded bubble wake; not a physical horn/weapon.
3) Bottom-left hit peak: brightest frame; bright aqua-white impact burst around the implied lance tip, cute star-splash shape with short radial water spikes, pearl bubbles, blue-violet rim light, tiny glitter dots.
4) Bottom-right dissolve: lance broken into translucent aqua crescent afterimages, drifting bubbles, faint ivory sparkles, soft circular ripple, clean readable footprint.

Style: project-native clean HD 2D game FX, crisp silhouette, smooth hand-painted glow, glossy underwater fantasy lighting, high contrast ivory/aqua/cyan/deep blue/violet palette, not pixel art. Exactly four FX frames only.
